faqs.question: What is the WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform, which lets a business connect WhatsApp to its ads, website and CRM, automate replies and flows, and let a team handle chats from a dashboard instead of one phone.

faqs.question: Is the WhatsApp Business API free?
faqs.answer: No. Meta charges per delivered message by category and country; messages from users to you are free. From 1 October 2026 service replies are charged after the first 1,000 free per number per month, and the provider charges its own platform fee.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the WhatsApp Business app and the API?
faqs.answer: The app is a free phone app for one person or a small team with basic auto-replies. The API supports full automation, CRM and ad integration and team inboxes, and charges per message.

faqs.question: Can WhatsApp chatbots be used for real estate?
faqs.answer: Yes, to answer common questions, send brochures and floor plans, qualify buyers and book site visits at any hour. The bot should answer only from approved project information and hand over to a person for negotiation, legal questions and complaints.

faqs.question: Can I send bulk WhatsApp messages to property buyers?
faqs.answer: Only to people who opted in. WhatsApp's Business Messaging Policy requires opt-in and approved templates for business-initiated messages, and numbers that get blocked or reported have their messaging limits cut. Bought lists also conflict with the DPDP Act, 2023.

faqs.question: What is the 24-hour window on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: When a user messages your business, a 24-hour customer service window opens in which you can reply with free-form messages. Outside it, you can only send approved template messages.

faqs.question: How long does WhatsApp Business API setup take?
faqs.answer: It depends on business verification and template approval by Meta. The steps are: choose a provider, verify the business, register a number, get templates approved, connect lead sources and CRM, then build and test the flow.

faqs.question: Which WhatsApp templates does a real estate business need?
faqs.answer: At least a welcome message with the brochure and a question, a site visit confirmation, a visit reminder, a no-show follow-up and an after-visit follow-up. Name the project and the buyer and include useful information in each.
